items.summary: DarwinX uses evolutionary algorithms to optimize LLM agent harnesses through multi-lineage search for robust task improvement.

items.summary: AutoDesign presents meta-optimization techniques for harness systems that transform multimodal sources into condensed structured outputs.

items.summary: OmniScientist is a multimodal AI scientist foundation model automating complete scientific workflows including hypothesis, code, and publication.

items.summary: SKILLER proposes language-level RL for extracting reusable skills in small LMs, enabling standardized packaging of procedural knowledge for agent systems. Relevant for developers building agent harnesses with constrained behavior spaces.

items.title: Ready Cohorts: Bounding GPU Opportunity and Avoiding Host Round Trips in LLM-Agent Control
items.snippet: LLM-agent services repeatedly execute small deterministic transitions between model and tool calls: route an outcome, update state, and emit the next effect. We ask when this control path exposes enough concurrent work for GPU execution, and what changes when a GPU-computed route decision remains on device. We formalize the ready-cohort boundary using fixed-partition share F, exact offline share P
items.summary: Research on GPU scheduling for LLM agent services to reduce latency and improve throughput in control path execution.
